exposure: Race/ethnicity (White, Asian, Hispanic, Black, Multiple race/other)
Cesarean delivery indication (failure to progress, fetal intolerance)
cohort: 16,587 nulliparous women with term, singleton, vertex presentation deliveries
finding: Compared to White women, all other racial/ethnic groups had higher odds of cesarean delivery, with Black women having the highest odds, followed by Asian, multiple race/other, and Hispanic women.
mod_finding: Compared to White women, all other racial/ethnic groups had higher odds of cesarean delivery, with Black women experiencing the highest odds.
